data.title: Predicted Lineups and Player Updates for Samsunspor vs Konyaspor 07/11/26 - Super Lig News
data.content:
Samsunspor will be hoping to return to winning ways here after the 5-2 Super Lig loss in their previous game against İstanbul Başakşehir. It’s our opinion that Kırmızı Şimşekler look set to kick off with a 3-5-2 system for this game, utilising Bilal Bayazit, Strahinja Erakovic, Gabriele Guarino, Igor Drapinski, Joe Mendes, Anto Sekongo, Elliot Watt, O. Øhlenschlæger, Logi Tomasson, Tanguy Coulibaly and Mohamed Bayo. [...] Following on from being defeated in their last game at the hands of Galatasaray in Super Lig competition, Konyaspor and their travelling supporters will be hoping that they can get a better result in this one. We reckon that Konyaspor will likely begin the game with a 4-2-3-1 formation, starting Deniz Ertas, Yhoan Andzouana, Rayyan Baniya, Chidozie Awaziem, Arthur Masuaku, Marko Jevtovic, Melih Ibrahimoglu, Ebrima Colley, Rajmund Tóth, Jean-Luc Dompe and Jackson Muleka. [...] Thanks to a mainly full-strength group of players, there is just the sole fitness worry for the Konyaspor manager İlhan Palut to be concerned with. Adil Demirbağ (Cruciate ligament tear) misses out for this game. Deniz Türüç cannot play in this game through suspension.
